summary: Gone tower listed as Sinking Creek Mountain in Craig / Montgomery, VA; the register calls the Earn Knob tower by this name too, so the record probably duplicates us-va-earn-knob.

facts.status_note: Forest Fire Lookout Association lists the Sinking Creek Mountain point as Tower Gone; the register gives the same tower the Earn Knob name

events.note: Earn Knob Tower Site, also called Sinking Creek Mountain Tower, registered July 31, 2018

evidence.supports: Association lists Sinking Creek Mountain, county Craig / Montgomery, Tower Gone, at 37.33277 -80.38917

corrections.proposed: Confirm whether this is the Earn Knob tower at 37.441667, -80.181111 (us-va-earn-knob); if so, merge the two records
corrections.why: The register says the Earn Knob tower is also called Sinking Creek Mountain Tower, but the association lists the two names at different points. The record may be a duplicate of us-va-earn-knob.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The association gives Craig / Montgomery for the Sinking Creek Mountain point. The register places the Earn Knob tower in Craig County only. The story reports the association's value and does not choose between them.

Both sources use the name Sinking Creek Mountain, but the association's point (37.33277, -80.38917) and the register's Earn Knob point (37.441667, -80.181111) differ. The story reports both and does not pick one.

notes_for_editor: Probable duplicate of us-va-earn-knob (story already published 2026-10-10). The register says the Earn Knob tower is also called Sinking Creek Mountain Tower, which is the basis for this story. The association lists the two names at different coordinates, about 22 km apart by our reckoning from the two pairs. Recommend merging the records after someone confirms the same tower; this story overlaps heavily with us-va-earn-knob.md. Build date is decade only (1930s), so no built event with a year is recorded. The gone status comes from the association list, which gives no removal date. No source read describes the site today. Did not reuse Wikipedia or Craig County history, which the Earn Knob story already cites. No photo added.
